year_display.zh: 1971 年（收 1960 年代所作小说）

review.en: Fourteen stories, written in California in the late 1960s, about people who came to Taipei from the mainland after 1949: a dance hostess, retired generals, a former opera singer. Pai Hsien-yung writes each in its own voice and makes the loss of a whole world felt through parties, funerals and old songs. Elegant, controlled and deeply moving.
review.zh: 十四篇小说，六十年代后期写于美国加州，写 1949 年后从大陆来到台北的人：舞女、退休的将军、昔日的昆曲名伶。白先勇为每一篇找到各自的声口，在宴会、葬礼和旧曲里写出一整个世界的失落。典雅、克制，深深动人。
